query:
SELECT
                a.user_id,
                a.team_id,
                a.created_by,
                a.computer_id,
                a.status,
                a.status_reason,
                a.created_at,
                u.email,
                COALESCE(mui.first_name, u.name, u.email) AS "name!"
            FROM team_agents a
            JOIN "User" u ON u.id = a.user_id
            LEFT JOIN macro_user_info mui ON mui.macro_user_id = u.macro_user_id
            WHERE a.team_id = $1
            ORDER BY a.created_at, a.user_id
